title: Drawing the sky before the sun
description: You can follow window setup and two layers of drawing.
source: draft: codex free model + edit: codex

steps.description: You create a window titled Sunny Day. canvas names its drawing surface.
setFill selects light blue using red, green and blue values. The rectangle starts at (0, 0) and covers the canvas.

steps.question: Which fill color will the oval use?
steps.answer: It uses yellow, selected by setFill immediately before the oval is drawn.

steps.description: The tutorial describes a yellow circle near the top-right corner, over the blue sky. You finish with wait to keep the window open; this example supplies no text output.
